summary: Duck presents a bearish short setup on Bitcoin around the 70-71k level, citing excessive leverage in the system and a lack of meaningful pullback during the massive 15k to 70k rally. He targets 60k as first support and 45k as more aggressive downside, while Cred provides historical context noting ATH breakouts typically don't mark major reversals. Both hosts discuss altcoin strategy - expressing bearish views through high-vol coins like SOL or buying discounted quality assets like ETH and narrative coins during corrections. The conversation also touches on the ETH ETF not being imminent due to regulatory complexity.
